description:
Open the presentation at /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/design_review.odp in LibreOffice Impress. Slide 1 contains three shapes that need to be rotated to specific angles for a technical diagram:

1. The blue rectangle shape ('Controller') — rotate it to exactly 90 degrees
2. The green arrow shape ('DataFlow') — rotate it to exactly 45 degrees
3. The red diamond shape ('IOPort') — rotate it to exactly 180 degrees

You can set precise rotation angles by selecting a shape and pressing F4 to open Position and Size, then using the Rotation tab or Angle field. Do not just eyeball it.

After rotating all three shapes, save the file (Ctrl+S) to the same location: /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/design_review.odp
